title: Too Dear: The Answer and the Counter
label: ch:mw-bargain
canDo: I can say that something is very expensive and ask for it a little cheaper, completing a three-turn bargaining exchange without learning a single new Devanagari sign.

payoff.summary: A strengthener, a softener, and a second asking word each arrive by ear before their spelling, join two source-printed lines, and close as a three-turn exchange scored separately in listening, speaking, reading, and writing.
